items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: I wouldn't say, I wouldn't call it Toman, but I could say... I wouldn't say, well, I guess that's a way of Toman, but it's a way of selling too

ctx.x: And it's affecting you, it's affecting the economy right now. But I can remember many a days when even myself, I had to take the low road in dealing with whites. Even today, in selling advertising, when I call on corporate people to sell advertising, I have to mellow myself a little bit, but I do my feasibility study and my homework because I know before I call on this individual, I just about know what he's like, who he is, and where he's coming from and what he likes, what his social background. Otherwise, I do…
I get you. You were involved, you were working at the weekly when Louis Armstrong came back in 65. When he made his...
